assessment: The observations establish delay and version mismatch, but do not identify their causes. These are candidate openings; neither establishes the 30-session success target or festival capacity.

openings.claim: Hypothesis: a caption audition mode could replay only changed cues with surrounding video, applying timed captions in the browser from private storage. Editors could inspect wording and timing immediately, then request the existing embedded-caption render for delivery.
openings.delta: Make the edited cue, rather than a newly rendered whole video, the immediate unit of inspection. Bind each audition and subsequent render to an immutable video/caption pair; retain the last delivered pair and original text.
openings.prediction: Correction sessions need fewer full renders while editors still detect planted wording and timing errors; browser and embedded previews agree on those judgments.
openings.probe: Timebox a staging prototype using demonstration footage. Have both editors assess planted errors through cue auditions and embedded previews. Measure disagreement, correctly identified preview time, processing hours, and engineering effort before testing 30 new sessions.
assumptions: Existing private infrastructure supports the audition within four engineer-days and one editor-day.
Cue context and browser timing are adequate for the edits tested; full embedded preview remains available where they are inadequate.

openings.claim: Does returning after an interruption erase the editor's remembered target, even when every preview is accurately labeled?
openings.delta: Test continuity of intent as a separate source of uncertainty: a persistent receipt records the selected video cut and a distinctive final caption excerpt before the editor leaves.
openings.prediction: With render waits, labels, and completion order held constant, interruption increases selection errors or selection time; the receipt selectively reduces that interruption penalty.
openings.probe: Use counterbalanced fabricated staging tasks crossing interruption/no interruption with receipt/no receipt. Log waiting and selection separately, and check selected pairs against the stipulated target. An absent interaction weakens this explanation.
assumptions: A small demonstration task set fits the shared editor-day budget; two editors provide exploratory evidence only.
